method: Conservative verse-by-verse thematic triage; checked repository overlap and public primary-text locator pages, but text was not exposed in retrieved pages. No primary text certified or public parallels asserted.

records.topic: God gives life and death; return to God
records.assessment: Deuteronomy 32:39 is a plausible monotheistic life/death comparison, but its Hebrew wording and context were not accessible for close comparison; no source association asserted.

records.topic: Admonition, healing of hearts, guidance and mercy
records.assessment: Healing and wisdom language is widespread; investigate precise pre-Islamic textual formulations before assigning a source.

records.topic: Rejoicing in divine favor and mercy
records.assessment: No distinctive prior narrative or source-specific relationship established in preliminary screening; not a claim of absence.

records.topic: Unauthorized declaring of divine provisions lawful and forbidden
records.assessment: Leviticus 11 contains food classifications but addresses authorized dietary instruction, not unauthorized human invention; comparison needs passage-specific verification.

records.topic: False attribution to God and expectation of judgment
records.assessment: Broad warning against false religious attribution; no distinctive primary-text correspondence verified.
